timeline.title: Genesis
timeline.subtitle: The Spark
timeline.text: We didn't just start a studio; we ignited a new way of seeing. By fusing human emotion with neural computing, we craft visual experiences that linger long after the screen goes dark.

timeline.title: Sagar Dhiman
timeline.subtitle: Chief Visionary
timeline.text: With an eye for the unseen, Sagar directs our creative pulse. He translates complex brand identities into cinematic masterpieces, ensuring every pixel tells a story of elegance and impact.

timeline.title: Shivam Dhiman
timeline.subtitle: Technical Maestro
timeline.text: The architect of our digital landscapes. Shivam masters the intersection of code and cinema, pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI to deliver flawless productions.

timeline.title: The Void
timeline.subtitle: Identifying the Gap
timeline.text: In a world saturated with generic content, authenticity has become the ultimate luxury. We saw brands losing their essence and decided to fight back with soul-driven logic.

timeline.title: Synthesis
timeline.subtitle: Our Blueprint
timeline.text: We blend performance-driven data with pure artistic intuition. This synthesis allows us to create content that isn't just seen—it's felt and remembered.

timeline.title: Legacy
timeline.subtitle: The Horizon
timeline.text: Our mission is to set the new benchmark for visual excellence. We are building a future where technology serves art, creating a lasting legacy for the brands we partner with.
